learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: 13 dispensary cards in the homepage's section#thc, 12 tagged ny (5 Stir STIK, 4 gummy, 4 vape cards; Tranquili-Tea is MA).
notes:
WordPress site with no product post type; the dispensary products are the cards in the homepage's section#thc: figure._productcard with h4 'Line
Flavor', h5 dose and format, and a state list ul li.ny / li.ma. The hemp D9 Stir STIKs sold online elsewhere on the page are outside section#thc and are not read.
h4 reads 'Social Tangerine', 'Relax Blue Raz', 'Flavor Forward Berry', 'Strain Series OG Kush': the effect lines are listed in the title rules, so a new line falls through to unparsed.

Gummy cards give the per-piece dose ('10mg THC, 5mg CBD, +THCv/CBC Gummies') but not the pack; NY stores sell them as 10pk 100mg ('MyHi - Tangie 2:1 THC:CBD Live Rosin Gummies 10pk - 100mg'), so a 10mg gummy is 10pk 100mg. Vapes are '1g Vape'; the site does not name the hardware (stores write 'Live Rosin Disposable'), so no subtype is set.
Stir STIK cards are skipped: three of the four NY cards cover two strengths ('5mg, 10mg Stir STIK') and none gives the pack (stores sell '3 x 10MG'). They come from the stores' consensus.
Stores write Social Tangerine as 'Tangie' (2026-10-05), too far from 'Tangerine' for the name match, so that store product also stays in the stores' consensus.
